post.yt_title: Why Did Jesus Have to Die? Couldn't God Just Forgive? ✝️ #shorts
post.yt_desc:
"Why did Jesus have to die? Couldn't God just forgive?" Fair question. Sin has a real cost: "For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord" (Romans 6:23 NKJV).

Forgiving a debt means someone pays it. Jesus paid. He came "to give His life a ransom for many" (Mark 10:45 NKJV). Then He rose. The gift is yours.

📖 Read it yourself: Romans 6:23 · Mark 10:45 · 1 Corinthians 15:3–4 (NKJV)
